scenario_description:
Objective: Complete cohort 6's already-started LRD-17 door-isolation practical within its scheduled morning session.
Emerging Need: After live-controls work begins, Rail Lab 2 loses rack power, and the instructor stops the required sequence because it cannot continue there.
Decision Context: Diagnostics initially remain pending; later, a compatible portable rig is briefly held while the continuity rule supplies the threshold, authority, route, and activation code for relocation.
Consequence: Prompt coordination can resume the same practical with the assembled cohort; once the held bay is assigned elsewhere, no compatible rig remains before release, and the interrupted attempt cannot be completed that morning.

parameter.title: LRD-17 door-isolation practical - cohort 6
parameter.description: Session TRN-LRD17-0113 for eight trainees. Instructor Jamal Price checked in the cohort and marked the live-controls practical started at 09:02. Completion and certification decisions remain with the instructor.

parameter.content: The cohort completed orientation and began the live door-isolation sequence. Rail Lab 2's control rack dropped power at 09:08, so I stopped hands-on work. The required live-controls sequence cannot continue while the rack is offline. Facilities is diagnosing it and expects to provide a restoration estimate by 09:18; all eight trainees remain assembled.

parameter.subject: Rail Lab 2 outage estimate and portable-rig availability
parameter.body: The failed rack power module cannot be restored before approximately 10:20. Safety Annex Bay C's portable rig is compatible with LRD-17 and available from 09:30 to 10:10. The annex custodian has placed a courtesy hold on that bay through 09:26; after that time it will be released to the waiting brake-systems class.

parameter.subject: Bay C courtesy hold released
parameter.body: The 09:30-10:10 Bay C hold expired at 09:26 and the waiting brake-systems class accepted the slot. It cannot be reclaimed. No other compatible portable-rig bay is available before 13:00 today.

parameter.name: 2026_LRD17_same_session_continuity_rule.txt
parameter.content:
LRD-17 Same-Session Continuity Rule
Approved: 2026-01-01

When an LRD-17 live-controls practical has started in Rail Lab 2 and equipment failure stops the required sequence, the workforce training coordinator may activate a no-cost relocation to the Safety Annex Bay C portable rig only if Facilities estimates restoration will take more than 30 minutes and the annex custodian confirms a held window of at least 35 minutes. The portable rig is approved for cohorts of up to ten trainees.

While the hold remains active, activation requires an email to safety.annex@regionaltransit.example containing session identifier TRN-LRD17-0113 and continuity code LRD17-C, with the assigned instructor copied. The coordinator may then send the operational relocation notice to that instructor. Relocation resumes the same practical and does not authorize the coordinator to record completion or make a certification decision.
